story: Explore the fascinating world of the Oriental Dollarbird (Eurystomus orientalis). Classified under the Coraciidae family, this bird predominantly inhabits Open woodland; forest edges; parks; gardens; mangroves; and riverine habitats. The current IUCN classification of Least Concern (LC) underscores the importance of safeguarding its natural range. From its feeding habits to its nesting preferences, the Oriental Dollarbird is a testament to the intricate web of life. By studying species like the Oriental Dollarbird, we gain valuable insights into broader ecological trends.
